interpretations: Count advancedbehavior records per trader type (tradekind), via advancedbehavior → transactionrecord → trader inner joins; share = count / total of those joined records, unrounded
Same as 1, but the share's denominator is the total number of advancedbehavior records, including those whose transaction or trader can't be found
Same as 1, but count distinct transactionrecord records (transreg) per trader type rather than advancedbehavior rows, so a trade with multiple behaviour records counts once
Same as 1, but count distinct traders per trader type that have at least one analysed trade record, with share relative to the total across types
Same as 1, but share expressed as a percentage (0–100) rather than a fraction (0–1), unrounded
Same as 1, but "analysed trade records" means compliancecase records linked to advancedbehavior (via abhvref), joined to the transaction and trader, counted per trader type

Same as 1, but share computed only among trader types that appear in the result (types with zero records excluded), versus including all four types (Market Maker, Broker, Individual, Institution) with zero counts shown
Same as 1, but records with null tradekind are grouped as their own category (or excluded) in counts and totals
Same as 1, but the denominator is the total count of all transactionrecord rows joined to traders, regardless of whether they have advancedbehavior records

Same as 1, but the denominator is the total of the per-type counts across all trader types, and trader types are taken from the trader table via a left join, so advancedbehavior records without a matching transaction or trader are grouped under a null or "Unknown" type
Same as 1, but the trader is reached through a different path: advancedbehavior → compliancecase (abhvref) → transactionrecord (transref) → trader, instead of through advancedbehavior.translink
Same as 1, but the trader is reached through the sentiment table: advancedbehavior → transactionrecord → sentimentandfundamentals → trader (trdref2), instead of through transactionrecord.trdref
Same as 1, but the share is rounded or formatted as a string, such as "12.5%"
queries:
SELECT t.tradekind,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt,
       CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*)
                                 FROM advancedbehavior a2
                                 JOIN transactionrecord tr2 ON a2.translink = tr2.transreg
                                 JOIN trader t2 ON tr2.trdref = t2.tradereg) AS share
FROM advancedbehavior a
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg
JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
GROUP BY t.tradekind

SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count
FROM advancedbehavior ab
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
GROUP BY t.tradekind;

SELECT 
  t.tradekind,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.tradereg) AS trader_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT t.tradereg) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT t.tradereg)) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct
FROM trader t
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
JOIN advancedbehavior ab ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
GROUP BY t.tradekind;

SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysed_trade_records
FROM compliancecase c
JOIN advancedbehavior a ON c.abhvref = a.abhvreg
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON c.transref = tr.transreg
JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
GROUP BY t.tradekind
